about: Inside You There Are Two Wolves shows a black wolf and a white wolf nose to nose in front of a huge full moon, with "Inside you there are two wolves" printed above them. The parody takes the solemn setup of the fable about a good wolf and an evil wolf fighting inside every person and swaps the moral struggle for something petty or absurd. The format usually ends with a flat summary line such as "you are both" or "both are you", which deflates the dramatic artwork completely.
origin: The image parodies the "Two Wolves" fable, often credited to Cherokee tradition though its real origin is uncertain, in which a grandfather tells a child that the wolf who wins is the one you feed. Parodies spread in late 2018 and early 2019.
usage:
The template already has "Inside you there are two wolves" printed at the top, so the single text box under the picture holds the rest: describe what each wolf wants, then close with a short verdict.

The classic structure is "one wants X, the other wants Y. you are both" or a twist where the two wolves agree on something terrible. Contradictory cravings, split personalities in gaming, procrastination versus panic and anxiety versus caffeine all land well. Keep it to two or three short sentences so it fits the caption area.
ideas: one uses tabs, one uses spaces. both are you.
one wants to save money. the other just found free shipping. you are broke.
one is tired. the other is also tired. you are at work.
one wants to sleep. one wants one more ranked game. you lose both.
one studies. one makes flashcards and never reads them. they are both you.
they are both hungry. you open the fridge for the ninth time.
aka: Inside You There Are Two Wolves
